errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen jährlich angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are spaced every two years (2016, 2018, 2020, etc.), not annually.
The left y-axis is scaled from 0 to 1,000, not 9,000. The description confuses the left and right axis scales.
The right y-axis is scaled from 0 to 9,000, not 8,000.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für die Handelspolitik ist schwarz
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the line for 'Handelspolitik' is purple ('Handelspolitik (rechte Skala)'), while the black line represents 'Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt'. The description incorrectly assigns the color black to the 'Handelspolitik' series.

errors.text_span: steigt dann bis Januar 2024 wieder auf etwa 100
errors.evidence: The black line ('Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt') does not return to 100 by 2024; instead, it shows a very sharp increase at the end of the period, rising to several hundred on the left scale.
The blue line ('Finanzpolitik') has a prominent peak in 2020 that reaches approximately 500 on the left scale, not 200.

errors.text_span: bevor sie wieder auf 100 im Januar 2024 zurückgeht
errors.evidence: The blue line ('Finanzpolitik') does not return to 100 by 2024; similar to the black line, it experiences a very sharp increase at the end of the period, rising to several hundred.
The x-axis only provides year labels, not specific months. Stating the data points are in 'Januar' (January) is an interpretation not directly supported by the axis labels.
